text:
claire_ops: FYI vendor (NimbusEdge) asked product + security for a "lite evidence pack" for their marketplace listing. They specifically called out: SOC excerpt, pen-test attestation, and HSM/KMS architecture confirmation. Need to confirm what we can hand them and how.

devrel_jay: What's their deadline?

partner_hw_pm: Legal needs something by Friday lunchtime. They prefer a single download (presigned) and a one-page README describing redactions.

claire_ops: We can do that. Proposed bundle: soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf, pen_attestation_trustassure.pdf (1p), kms_hsm_statement.txt, readme_marketplace.txt, manifest.json.

security_lead: Redaction rules: strip IPs, internal hostnames, employee PII. SOC excerpt should be control mappings + auditor name only. Pen attestation must state scope and signed vendor name; no exploit details.

sec_ops_bot: [automated] Evidence retention policy: default TTL 72h for external presigned links unless compliance approves longer. Owner required. Tag: marketplace-evidence/v2.

claire_ops: I'll own uploads. I'll produce presigned tarball `nimbus_bundle.tar.gz` and individual object presigns if they ask.

devrel_jay: For the KMS/HSM note, partner wants assurance we don't export keys to third parties and whether keys are HSM-backed. Can we provide a one-paragraph architecture snippet?

security_lead: Yes. Sample phrasing: "Redwood uses HSM-backed symmetric CMKs in AWS KMS for service encryption of model artifacts. Customer BYOK is supported via API; Redwood never exports customer-managed key material. Operational access to Redwood-managed keys requires KMS IAM roles and is logged."

claire_ops: I'll add a small ascii diagram in kms_hsm_statement.txt and reference internal diagram URL (private).

partner_hw_pm: They also asked for who performed the pen test and whether it's 3rd party. Please include vendor name and date in the attestation doc.

security_lead: We have a TrustAssure attestation dated 2025-06-12. I'll prepare the signed one-page attestation, redact hostnames, and include vendor signature block.

claire_ops: Manifest format I'll use: 
``` 
{ 
  "artifact_name": "nimbus_bundle.tar.gz", 
  "items": ["soc2_excerpt_redacted.pdf","pen_attestation_trustassure.pdf","kms_hsm_statement.txt","readme_marketplace.txt"], 
  "owner": "claire_ops", 
  "ttl_hours": "72", 
  "redaction": "IPs/hostnames/PII removed" 
} 
```

devrel_jay: Small ask: add README that lists contact (security@redwood.com) and instructions to request extended retention.

sec_ops_bot: [automated] Remember to label artifacts with taxonomy `marketplace-evidence/v2` and include owner metadata in object tags.

claire_ops: Plan: (1) security_lead prepares attestation + KMS text now, (2) I run redaction checklist and assemble bundle, (3) create presigned link(s) and drop into partner intake. Target: upload by 2025-08-21 11:30 PT.

partner_hw_pm: That works. If you can share the presign DM once ready that'd be perfect.

security_lead: I'll post attestation in this thread when ready for redaction review.

claire_ops: Noted. Will follow up in ~3 hours. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
